shots.start_state: No motion yet; target begins on the observation deck with the dark-uniformed woman and the waiting fleet outside the window.
shots.action: The opening frame mirrors the source composition and stays nearly still; a subtle handheld tremor builds as the deck hum begins.
shots.end_state: The woman remains centered in silhouette with the fleet outside; alarm has not yet begun.

shots.start_state: Observation deck before the alert; no active alarm or strobe.
shots.action: Hard cut to a tight console close-up; a gloved hand presses an amber switch, red alert panels strobe rapidly.
shots.end_state: Alarm state is active in the deck.

shots.start_state: Alarm active; no bridge shake yet.
shots.action: Hard cut back to the woman from behind; the deck begins to shake harder and her ponytail shifts with the vibration.
shots.end_state: Bridge vibration visibly present while the fleet waits.

shots.start_state: Alarm and deck vibration continue; fleet is still waiting outside.
shots.action: Hard cut to an exterior view of the dark capital ships; engine pods flare with pale blue-white exhaust and the ships begin to move.
shots.end_state: The fleet is moving and charging toward a departure window.
sound_cues: shockwave rumble carried through station structure

shots.start_state: Fleet engines are lit and moving; alarm is still audible.
shots.action: Hard cut back inside near the window; lights strobe rapidly, dust shakes, and jump-charge reflections crawl across the metal frame.
shots.end_state: Jump energy is visually at maximum; ship is about to warp.

shots.start_state: Jump charge is at maximum; the woman is still on the observation deck.
shots.action: An intense blue-white warp flash floods the window, the whole deck shakes strongly, and the shot breaks through two short black frames before landing on empty star trails where the fleet used to be.
shots.end_state: The window now shows empty star trails and nebula; the fleet is gone.
sound_cues: abrupt cut to low hover tone

shots.start_state: After the fade from the black-frame impact, the same observation window is now empty of the fleet; the dark uniformed woman remains in silhouette.
shots.action: Hard cut to the window composition; the first title line fades up out of the darkest upper nebula area, is swept by a starlight band, and begins expanding its letter spacing.
shots.end_state: The first line THE LAST FLEET LEFT EARTH is clearly readable with a restrained metallic glow.

shots.start_state: First title line is visible in the upper window area; second line has not appeared yet.
shots.action: A tighter view holds the first title line while a two-frame black flash at the start of the beat ushers in the second title line below it; letter spacing continues widening and a faint afterimage trails the glyphs.
shots.end_state: Both title lines are visible and widely tracked over the dark empty window.

shots.start_state: Both lines are visible and wide-tracked, but not yet at full final spacing.
shots.action: Slow push-in continues; the letter spacing reaches its widest point, material texture and restrained edge halo become fully apparent, then a short black-frame flash restores both lines in the final frame.
shots.end_state: Final composition holds both exact title lines over deep space with pearl-grey metallic type, faint glow and edge halo.
sound_cues: short low impact at the final black flash
